$comment: Machine-readable run-list for the Snake game's bitmap art -- two sprites (apple, title). The grass field is drawn in canvas, not a bitmap. Each `prompt` is fully self-contained: it already states the subject, style, palette (with hex), framing, aspect ratio, background and the no-text rule, so you can paste any single `prompt` value into any image model and run it as-is -- no other field is a missing instruction. The sibling fields (`aspect`, `resize`, `transparency`, `background`, `chromaKey`) only restate the key facts in machine form and drive post-processing. Do not paraphrase a `prompt`. Human context and the what/why is in art-assets.md.
globalConstraints: No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in any image (a word baked into a bitmap is a string the i18n layer cannot translate). Every prompt already says this -- it is repeated here as the review checklist.
Flat vector / sticker style, clean edges, even flat lighting, no photorealism.
Keep each file small -- it is precached by the service worker and downloaded before the game is playable offline.
Output format is .webp (carries alpha, stays small).
For any asset with transparency:true the image model paints an opaque background, not an alpha channel -- the prompt asks for a flat magenta #FF00FF fill; src/assets.ts colour-keys it out at load.

assets.role: The food, drawn at roughly one grid cell, gently pulsing.
assets.background: flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow
assets.chromaKey: src/assets.ts keys out pixels within distance 64 of #FF00FF
assets.prompt: A single glossy cartoon apple, centered and filling most of a square 1:1 frame, flat vector sticker illustration style with a thin clean darker-red outline, even flat lighting, no photorealism. Bright cherry-red body, one short curved green leaf at the top, one soft white highlight on the upper left, front view. Place it on a completely uniform solid magenta background, hex #FF00FF, with absolutely no gradient, no vignette, no drop shadow and no reflection, so the background can be removed cleanly afterwards. Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
assets.postProcess: The magenta must be one even colour edge to edge, or the chroma-key leaves a halo.
assets.acceptCheck: Apple fills the frame, background is one uniform magenta, no lettering.

assets.role: The mascot on the blue start card.
assets.background: flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow
assets.chromaKey: src/assets.ts keys out pixels within distance 64 of #FF00FF; render draws a soft white halo behind it
assets.prompt: A cute cartoon snake mascot curled up resting in a spiral, centered and filling most of a square 1:1 frame, flat vector sticker illustration style, soft even lighting, no photorealism. Rounded royal-blue body, hex #3B5BC0, with a thin white outline all the way around it, big friendly white eyes with dark pupils and a small happy closed smile, front view. Place it on a completely uniform solid magenta background, hex #FF00FF, with absolutely no gradient, no vignette, no drop shadow and no reflection, so the background can be removed cleanly afterwards. Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
assets.postProcess: The magenta must be one even colour edge to edge. The thin white outline is what makes the blue body read against the blue card.
assets.acceptCheck: Friendly coiled snake, one uniform magenta background, thin white outline present, no lettering.

afterGenerating: Eyeball both files: zero text/letters/numbers (testplan S10).
For apple.webp and title.webp confirm the background is a single flat magenta.
Run `pnpm build` from the repo root; confirm dist/g/snake/art/ contains apple.webp and title.webp (they precache via the `webp` glob, testplan S3).
`git add games/snake/public/art` and commit as task T3.
In games/snake/docs/progress.md: set T3 to done, tick the art parts of testplan M17 and S10.
